risk_if_not_implemented: Without Data Backup Access, data, software and system images cannot be reliably restored within required recovery objectives following a disruption. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Excessive or Unauthorized Privilege (R-AC-2), Unauthorized Access (R-AC-4), Loss of Confidentiality (R-IP-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Alternate Storage Site
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to establish an alternate storage site that stores both the assets and necessary agreements needed for the recovery of Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD).
compensating_control_1.justification: Alternate Storage Site (BCD-12) provides resilience and recovery capability that compensates for the absence of Backup Access (BCD-30) by ensuring the organization can restore operations and data when the primary control is absent. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Data Backup & Restoration Hardware Protection
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to protect data backup and restoration hardware and software.
compensating_control_2.justification: Data Backup & Restoration Hardware Protection (BCD-31) provides resilience and recovery capability that compensates for the absence of Backup Access (BCD-30) by ensuring the organization can restore operations and data when the primary control is absent. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
